title: On the Annunciation (Sermo I tip)
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Vossius 1684 Opera omnia Latin column (In annuntiationem Sermo I); tip densify opening through Gabriel reply; Greek column OCR damaged
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, On the Annunciation — tip densify of Sermo I opening from the 1684 Latin column. New English for private study; ANF 6 Salmond exists. Three sermons survive in the Vossius edition; this tip covers the opening only.
era_note: The Annunciation sermons stand under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name in the Neocaesarean tradition as transmitted by Vossius; later Latin presentation and authenticity questions are disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Salmond, PD); this is a new rendering from locked Latin for the tipped opening.

text_history.method: English densified from locked Vossius 1684 Latin column for tip Sermo I opening; Greek column OCR too damaged to lock; Vossius scholia stripped; ANF 6 consulted only as sense check; earlier scaffold paraphrase discarded.

joins.note: Long-s and column joins expanded from the Latin face; Greek face left aside as damaged OCR.
